disclaimer_body: PoshanCare provides educational nutritional observations based on ICMR-NIN guidelines. It does not provide medical diagnoses or prescriptions.
pediatric_notice: Child and teen profiles prioritize healthy physical growth, energetic vitality, and nutrient density. Calorie restriction and dieting are not recommended.
older_adult_notice: Nutrition guidance for older adults emphasizes optimal hydration and protein distribution for healthy muscle and bone density.
allergens_warning: Always verify food ingredients if you have known food sensitivities or medical allergies.
